name: Modules.Geofence.Region
summary: Represents a geographic region to be monitored.
description:
A Region is a circular area defined by a center point (latitude, longitude) and a radius in meters. 
Use the [Geofence.createRegion](api:Modules.Geofence#createRegion) method to create a region.

properties.name: center
properties.summary: An object representing the center coordinate for the region.
properties.description:
The object must contain the following properties:
  
  * `latitude`: The latitude of the point to be tested
  * `longitude`: The longitude of the point to be tested

properties.name: identifier
properties.summary: The unique identifier of the region.

properties.name: notifyOnEntry
properties.summary: A boolean that controls whether the region will notify on entry.
properties.description:
If `true`, an [enterregions](api:Modules.Geofence#enterregions) event is generated when the device enters the region.
If `false`, no event is generated. Default is `true`.

This property can only be set when calling [Geofence.createRegion()](api:Modules.Geofence#createRegion).

properties.name: notifyOnExit
properties.summary: A boolean that controlls whether the region will notify on exit.
properties.description:
If `true`, an [exitregions](api:Modules.Geofence#exitregions) event is generated when the device exit the region.
If `false`, no event is generated. Default is `true`.

This property can only be set when calling [Geofence.createRegion()](api:Modules.Geofence#createRegion).

properties.name: radius
properties.summary: The radius of the region to monitor in meters.

methods.name: containsCoordinate
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the coordinates passed to the method represent a point that is within the region.

parameters.name: point
parameters.summary: A Dictionary that defines `latitude` and `longitude` properties.
